title: Identification of N4-Acetylcytidine-Related Biomarkers in Adult Asthma: An Integrative Multi-Omics Study.
summary: Mendelian randomization, machine-learning biomarker selection, single-cell analysis and RT-qPCR identified MCM5, PUM1, TRIP6, PALM and NPEPL1 as candidate adult-asthma biomarkers.
ai_technology: Mendelian randomization, machine learning and expression analysis
organization: The Eighth Affiliated Hospital of Sun Yat-Sen University

evidence.tested: MR classified three genes as protective and two as risk factors; a nomogram, single-cell analysis and mouse RT-qPCR supported the candidates, but mechanistic and clinical validation remain needed.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
evidence.ai_role: Mendelian randomization, machine learning and expression analysis enabled the stated case-specific result.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
